# VIENA2

Virtual driving scenarios designed for action anticipation.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** A virtual driving clip with available steering and speed measurements.

**Output / label:** An upcoming scenario action such as a driver maneuver or pedestrian event.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://sites.google.com/view/viena2-project/home)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://sites.google.com/view/viena2-project/home)

## Intention in this dataset

Predict simulated future actions in driver, pedestrian and front-car scenarios; class labels encode future behavior rather than directly observed private intention.

**Relevance:** `implicit` · **Origin:** `synthetic` · **Year:** 2018

**Domains:** driver_behavior, pedestrian, autonomous_driving  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver, pedestrian_crossing, action  
**Tasks:** action_anticipation, behavior_prediction  
**Modalities:** rgb, vehicle_telemetry  
**Formats:** video, time_series, structured_annotation

## Limits and notes

The five scenarios include accidents and traffic-rule events as well as human behavior; not every class is an intention label.
